copper mountain.note: New snow overnight! 1 inch in the last 12 hours with a little more to fall in the early AM. Temps will be in the mid-20s with 5-10 mph winds from the west. Be sure to check out the whole mountain as the American Flyer is open along with the American Eagle and Easy Rider! Keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram for opening alerts. Our crews are out there now hard at work filling our trails with snow. A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space. Hope to see you out there!

eldora.note: 5:03 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Tuesday, November 24, 2026. HAPPY OPENING DAY! We are officially open for alpine skiing and riding. We couldn’t be more excited to welcome you, our devoted community members, back for another great season at your backyard mountain. We are so proud of our incredibly hardworking employees, whose relentless efforts have allowed us to open today, the Tuesday before Thanksgiving. They deserve a HUGE round of applause. Terrain: We'll have 1,000 vertical feet of downhill riding and skiing on Hornblower and International trails, from the summit of Challenge Mountain to the base area, served by Alpenglow chairlift. No beginner terrain is available—nor is uphill access, Nordic skiing, or snowshoeing—but we're pushing to open those zones of operation as soon as conditions permit. A small Woodward Terrain Park will be available near West Wing Lodge. Please note that valid passes or tickets are required to access the hike park and the mountain in general. For more on what to expect today, read our Opening Day blog post here . NWS Weather Snapshot: Sunny, with a high near 33. West wind 8 to 10 mph, with gusts as high as 16 mph. Safety: No trees or glades will be open. Expect thin, early-season conditions on Opening Day and beyond. Be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly on Opening Day and all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes. Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates. Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here . Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions , for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply). ELDORA for general alerts UPHILL for uphill-specific updates NORDIC for Nordic updates. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week . Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com .

snowbird.note: Guess what all you skiers & snowboarders? The long wait is almost over... Snowbird opens tomorrow!
